why_not_one_block_off: Sheet 42 covers 18th-21st, sheet 45 covers 21st-24th; 21st is the only shared street and both plates spell it out in the corridor as '21ST OR CENTER ST.' (sheet 42 bottom edge, sheet 45 top edge), with the width '80'' printed inside it on both. Address runs pin the block: sheet 42's north frontage reads 1502 1504 1506 1508 1510 1512 | 1514 1516 1518 1520 1522 1524 (the Avenue N to Avenue N 1/2 block, split by the 20' alley) and then 1602 1604 1606 1608 1610 east of Avenue N 1/2; sheet 45's south frontage reads ...1321 1323 then 1401 1403 1405 1407 1409 1411 | 1413 1415 1417 1419 1421 1423 (its Avenue M 1/2 to Avenue N block), ending at Avenue N where sheet 42's 1500 run begins - the M1/2-N=1400, N-N1/2=1500 chain is continuous across the two plates, so the sheets meet at the Avenue N / 21st St corner. One street north on sheet 42 is 20th (faces 2386/2629), one south on sheet 45 is 22nd (faces 1245/1488); neither is shared. Detection's candidates (42: 3693/2554/1415/276; 45: 658/1819/2981) were discarded. Positions are the mid-line of the 80' corridor: sheet 42 faces y=3535 and y=3778 -> 3657; sheet 45 faces y=103 and y=343 -> 219.
